title: NVIDIA Config Manager workflow form v1
description: The version 1 response of GET /v1/workflow/{form_id}/form. schema is the form projection of the workflow input model's JSON Schema, ui_schema is the supported subset of an RJSF uiSchema, and requires lists the capabilities a UI must support before it renders the form. Model-aware references are checked when the workflow form catalog builds.

schema.description: Form projection of the input model's Pydantic JSON Schema, passed to RJSF as schema.

ui_schema.description: Rendering directives for the projected form schema.

ui_schema_version.description: Version of the ui_schema contract used by this response.

requires.description: Capabilities this form uses. Deliberately open: an unknown entry makes an older UI show its unsupported state instead of rendering.

nonBlankString.description: A string containing at least one non-whitespace character.

propertyName.description: A property-style identifier used for schema properties, modes, and item properties.

scalarValue.description: A scalar value allowed in static option-source parameters.

optionParamValue.description: A static query parameter; a list becomes a repeated parameter.

queryAliases.description: Already-shipped URL query-parameter aliases, emitted only from the server's central compatibility map.

exclusiveGroup.description: One input mode in a mutually exclusive interaction. fields are projected properties; deviceFilters includes the non-model filters rendered by named device fields.

fields.description: Projected properties belonging to this input mode.

deviceFilters.description: Device fields whose non-model filter controls also activate this input mode.

requireComplete.description: Require one complete input mode and every field in the active mode before submission. When used, every group in the set must enable it.

fieldComparison.description: Client-side comparison between two projected numeric fields.

left.description: Projected numeric field that receives the validation error.

operator.description: Comparison the left value must satisfy against the right value.

right.description: Projected numeric field compared against the left value.

message.description: Validation message displayed when the comparison fails.

dependency.description: A sibling form property whose value supplies one option query parameter. A required dependency holds the request while empty; an optional one is omitted while empty.

field.description: Projected sibling property whose value supplies the dependency.

required.description: When false, omit an empty dependency instead of holding the request.

optionSource.description: Where a core field loads its options. endpoint is a path relative to the workflow API origin; a whole {property} path segment is filled from that sibling property and is a required dependency.

endpoint.description: API path relative to the workflow API origin; whole {property} segments reference sibling form values.

label_key.description: Response-object property containing each option's display label.

value_key.description: Response-object property containing each option's submitted value.

type_key.description: Optional response-object property containing each option's type or group.

params.description: Static query parameters included with every option request.

depends_on.description: Query parameter names mapped to sibling form-property dependencies.

clear_on_change.description: Clear the selected value when a dependency changes.

apiOptionsFieldOptions.description: Rendering and data-source options for the apiOptions core field.

source.description: API source that supplies selectable options.

presentation.description: Control used to present the loaded options.

selectAll.description: Show a Select All control for grouped checkboxes.

showDescriptions.description: Show option descriptions from an enriched response.

disableWhenNoMatches.description: Disable the field when response metadata reports zero matching devices.

metaText.description: Response metadata displayed beside the option control.

label.description: Human-readable label shown before the metadata value.

queryAliases.description: Legacy URL query parameters accepted for this field.

querySeparator.description: Legacy delimiter accepted inside each query parameter for this multi-select field.

locationFieldOptions.description: Rendering and data-source options for the location core field.

source.description: API source that supplies selectable locations.

typeField.description: Sibling property that receives the selected location's type.

queryAliases.description: Legacy URL query parameters accepted for this field.

deviceFilterSources.description: Option sources for the enabled semantic device filters. Keys must exactly match the device field's filters; model-aware registration enforces that relationship.

site.description: API source that supplies selectable Site and Module locations, including their location type.

tenant.description: API source that supplies selectable tenants.

status.description: API source that supplies selectable device statuses.

deviceFieldOptions.description: Rendering, filtering, and data-source options for the device core field.

source.description: API source that supplies selectable devices.

filters.description: Filter controls shown above the device picker.

filterSources.description: Backend-owned API sources keyed by each enabled semantic filter.

siteRequired.description: Whether a Site must be selected before devices can be loaded.

siteField.description: Sibling location property used instead of an inline Site filter.

filterScope.description: Identifier used to share one filter state across device fields.

queryParam.description: URL query parameter used to prefill the selected device value.

queryAliases.description: Legacy URL query parameters accepted for this field.

standardFieldOptions.description: Supported ui:options for a standard RJSF field.

rows.description: Visible row count for a multiline text control.

variantRowsChoice.description: One static choice shown by a select column.

value.description: String submitted when the choice is selected.

variantRowsColumn.description: One input column repeated in every row of a mode. arrayProperty names the projected top-level array; itemProperty names a string property inside object-array items.

arrayProperty.description: Projected top-level array property populated by this column.

itemProperty.description: String property populated within each object-array item; omit for scalar arrays.

kind.description: Input control rendered for this column.

placeholder.description: Hint shown while the column input is empty.

required.description: Whether every nonblank row must contain a value for this column.

pattern.description: Regular expression used to validate nonempty text values.

choices.description: Static choices available to a select column.

variantRowsMode.description: One mutually exclusive row layout, such as interfaces or GUIDs.

columns.description: Columns rendered for every row in this mode.

variantRowsFieldOptions.description: Configuration for a composite row editor that exclusively controls several projected array properties.

ownedProperties.description: Projected array properties written exclusively by this composite field, including its anchor.

modes.description: Mutually exclusive row layouts offered to the user.

minimumRows.description: Minimum number of editable rows kept visible.

clearInactive.description: Clear properties owned by inactive modes when the active mode changes.

warning.description: Warning displayed below the row editor.

fieldUiSchema.description: Supported rendering directives for one projected top-level form property.

ui:help.description: Supporting help text displayed with the field.

ui:description.description: UI-specific description displayed with the field.

ui:placeholder.description: Hint displayed while the field is empty.

ui:widget.description: Standard RJSF widget used to render the field.

ui:field.description: Registered core field used to render and manage the property.

ui:readonly.description: Whether the rendered field is read-only.

ui:options.description: Field-specific options validated according to ui:field.

uiSchema.description: The supported subset of an RJSF uiSchema: root options plus one entry per top-level schema property.

ui:order.description: Top-level property rendering order; an optional * inserts unlisted properties.

submitText.description: Text displayed on the submit button.

ui:globalOptions.description: Rendering options applied to the whole form.

hideSchemaDescriptions.description: Hide descriptions inherited from the projected input schema.

exclusiveGroups.description: Mutually exclusive input modes. A value in one mode disables and clears the others.

fieldComparisons.description: Client-side comparisons between projected numeric fields.
